_what: Measured latency of the reported method on one idle RTX A5000. Every timing number in the paper is derived from THIS file by scripts/make_timing_numbers.py; none is typed into main.tex.
_why: The fit-cost argument is one of the paper's two main claims, and until 2026-08-01 every number behind it existed only as prose in main.tex with nothing in the repo to reproduce it. That is how the previous figures (21-701 s to fit, 2-25 ms for the head, nnU-Net 3260 s 'regardless of field size') survived for months while being wrong: the per-image one by two orders of magnitude, the nnU-Net one in both value and invariance.
_conditions: GPU1 (RTX A5000) with BOTH cards idle: nvidia-smi read 0 MiB / 0% on GPU0 and GPU1 immediately before the run and again after it (logs/timing_idle_proof.txt), so unlike the 2026-07-31 measurement no campaign cell was sharing the machine. Method head_fusion_best_nobank_noloss_nocolor_flat_es_ep500_wd4_do5_mix_noaux -- the REPORTED lean configuration -- K=8, res 672, 3 repeats per dataset each drawing a DIFFERENT support subset, so the spread is over draws. `bank_only_ms` is carried over from 2026-07-31: the frozen bank is unchanged and that field feeds only \bankShareOfMask, which the paper does not cite.
_source: scripts/timing_bench.py via timing_now.sh (fit/encode/predict, re-measured 2026-09-02); nnU-Net rows unchanged from scripts/nnunet_bench.py, registry C66.

nnunet.check: iou 0.8543 against the campaign's 0.851, so the run is valid and not merely slow
did not finish inside a 9000 s cap; the true cost is larger, so every ratio derived from it is conservative in nnU-Net's favour
